text:
marta: quick sync: exploring a "mini-compare" control that lives inline above the heatmap. Goal: fast p95 + throughput glance, pin two windows, peek overlaps without full timepicker swap. mock: https://files.redwood/mini-compare.png

sam: Inline sounds much nicer than toggling panels. How will it behave on narrow screens?

marta: responsive: collapses to a single compact pill on <720px. tap opens full-width comparator. desktop keeps inline strip.

jin: For metrics, propose left shows p95 spark, center shows range bars, right shows throughput spark. Hover tooltip includes p50/p95/throughput and sample-rate.

uma: Sample-rate visibility: badge reads `1/20`. tooltip: `Sample rate: 1 in 20 requests` with link to sampler settings. Allow quick toggle in tooltip: `Pause sampling` / `Edit`

lee: Accessibility: ensure the badge isn't the only color cue 1 for sampled state. Use icon + text and a focus-visible outline. Keyboard: tab into strip, arrows move focus across ranges, enter pins/unpins, space opens sample popover. Use `aria-roledescription=\"time range comparator\"`.

sam: Implementation idea: render ranges as buttons with `aria-pressed` when pinned. That gives screen readers clear state. Avoid role=slider.

jin: Overlap semantics: when two ranges overlap show an overlapping hatch and tooltip: "Overlap: weighted stats by requests". Also add a tiny `Merge` action in tooltip to compute a combined baseline for comparisons.

uma: Copy suggestion for microcopy: "Pin ranges to compare p95 & throughput. Overlaps are weighted by request count." Shorten to: "Pin to compare p95 & throughput. Overlaps use weighted stats."

lee: A11y check: contrast for hatch pattern must pass 3:1. Also ensure the keyboard focus indicator is 3px thick and visible even in high-contrast OS theme. Test with NVDA + Chrome.

sam: Dev tasks: debounce hover syncing with heatmap to avoid flicker; store per-user state in localStorage; write e2e for narrow-screen collapse. CI flagged `heatmap-hover.test` earlier; I'll pick that up.

ci-bot: CI: branch `mini/compare-strip` 1 build checks: 3/4 passed. failing: `heatmap-hover.test`

marta: Good. Jin add analytics: `mini_compare.interact` with props: action, base_range, compare_range, sample_rate, overlap_pct. Uma finalize sampler tooltip copy and quick toggle UX. Lee run a11y smoke and send notes. Sam fix hover debounce + mobile collapse test. I'll update the mock with the compact pill state and post final screenshot here.

uma: One more UX thought: long-press on a pinned range could open a small menu: `Unpin`, `Zoom to range`, `Copy range`. Useful for quick ops without opening full timepicker.

sam: Love that. Confirmed: double-click clears pin. single-click toggles pin. long-press opens menu. We'll document all interactions in the component README.

marta: Perfect. I'll aim to upload screenshot by EOD tomorrow. Thanks :raised_hands:
